description:
Get clinical data for samples in a study.
Data: cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics (public studies) · table sample — one record = one specimen of one patient in one study.
Key: studyId, sampleId.
Arguments: study_id accepts cbio study (resolved; unknown -> error); sample_ids accepts cbio sample (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.patient` counts patients.
OS_MONTHS, OS_STATUS, DFS_MONTHS, DFS_STATUS ... are patient values repeated on each row; count patients with `_vbt.grains.patient`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence.

sample_ids.description: Accepts cbio_sample; resolved to one cbio_sample (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

study_id.description: Accepts cbio_study; resolved to one cbio_study (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
